"""Build the fixed-scene acrylic copy using region medial paths and in-region connectors."""
import os,time,json,heapq,math
import numpy as np,cv2
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from geom import resample

BASE='/app/output'
PIX=.22185986964255727
PRESS=np.array([0,.5,1,3,5,7,9,11,13,14.2])
WIDTH=np.array([3,5.5,7.5,10.9,15.7,22,32,49,73,91])

def connector(a,b,mask,dist):
 a=np.asarray(a);b=np.asarray(b)
 straight=resample(np.array([a,b]),1)
 xy=np.round(straight).astype(int)
 if np.all(mask[xy[:,1],xy[:,0]]):return straight
 # A* through a coarse grid; favour the interior of the region.
 stride=3
 h,w=mask.shape
 start=(round(a[1]/stride),round(a[0]/stride)); goal=(round(b[1]/stride),round(b[0]/stride))
 gm=mask[::stride,::stride];gd=dist[::stride,::stride]
 gh,gw=gm.shape
 start=(min(gh-1,start[0]),min(gw-1,start[1]));goal=(min(gh-1,goal[0]),min(gw-1,goal[1]))
 # include nearest cells of valid points
 def valid(p):
  if gm[p]:return p
  cand=[(max(0,min(gh-1,p[0]+dy)),max(0,min(gw-1,p[1]+dx))) for dy in range(-3,4) for dx in range(-3,4)]
  cand=[q for q in cand if gm[q]]
  return min(cand,key=lambda q:(q[0]-p[0])**2+(q[1]-p[1])**2) if cand else p
 start=valid(start);goal=valid(goal)
 pq=[(0.,start)];cost={start:0};prev={};found=False
 moves=[(dy,dx,math.hypot(dy,dx)) for dy in [-1,0,1] for dx in [-1,0,1] if dx or dy]
 while pq:
  _,p=heapq.heappop(pq)
  if p==goal:found=True;break
  for dy,dx,d in moves:
   q=(p[0]+dy,p[1]+dx)
   if not(0<=q[0]<gh and 0<=q[1]<gw and gm[q]):continue
   nc=cost[p]+d*(1+2/(gd[q]+1))
   if nc>=cost.get(q,1e30):continue
   cost[q]=nc;prev[q]=p
   heapq.heappush(pq,(nc+math.hypot(q[0]-goal[0],q[1]-goal[1]),q))
 if not found:return straight
 p=goal;out=[p]
 while p!=start:p=prev[p];out.append(p)
 route=np.array(out[::-1])[:,::-1]*stride
 return np.vstack([a,route,b])

def join_region(region,labels):
 k=region['color'];ps=[np.array(p,float) for p in region['paths']]
 mask=cv2.GaussianBlur((labels==k).astype(np.float32),(0,0),1.2)>.5
 dist=ndi.distance_transform_edt(np.pad(mask,1))[1:-1,1:-1]
 # order paths by proximity and retain contact along safe interior connectors
 ix=max(range(len(ps)),key=lambda i:len(ps[i]));out=ps.pop(ix).tolist()
 while ps:
  end=np.array(out[-1][:2])
  opts=[(np.linalg.norm(p[j,:2]-end),i,j) for i,p in enumerate(ps) for j in [0,-1]]
  _,ix,j=min(opts);path=ps.pop(ix)
  if j==-1:path=path[::-1]
  co=connector(end,path[0,:2],mask,dist)
  co=resample(co,3)
  xy=np.round(co).astype(int)
  wid=np.clip(dist[xy[:,1],xy[:,0]]*1.4,3.5,40)
  out.extend(np.c_[co,wid].tolist());out.extend(path.tolist())
 return np.array(out)

class RobotPaint:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.p=s.primitives();self.target=s.tip_pose()[0].copy()
 def move(self,pos,speed=.04,settle=0):
  pos=np.array(pos,float);start=self.target.copy()
  n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(pos-start)*20/speed)))
  for i in range(1,n+1):
   goal=start+(pos-start)*(i/n)
   q,ok,err=self.s.ik(goal)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK',goal,err))
   self.s.step(q)
  self.p['hold'](settle);self.target=pos
 def dip(self,k):
  self.move([self.target[0],self.target[1],.055],.10,3)
  xy=self.s.wells()[k]['center_xy']
  self.move([*xy,.055],.17,3);self.move([*xy,.026],.04,4)
  self.move([*xy,.055],.08,4)
 def point(self,p):
  x,y=self.s.geo.px_to_world(p[0],p[1])
  press=max(.6,float(np.interp(p[2],WIDTH,PRESS)))
  return np.array([x,y,.020-press/1000])
 def stroke(self,path):
  pos=self.point(path[0]);self.move([pos[0],pos[1],.045],.17,4)
  self.move(pos,.04,4)
  for p in path[1:]:self.move(self.point(p),.035)
  self.p['hold'](4)
  self.move([self.target[0],self.target[1],.045],.08,4)

def main():
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);s.record_start();rp=RobotPaint(s)
 plan=json.load(open(BASE+'/plan.json'));labels=np.load(BASE+'/labels.npy')
 last=None;t=time.time()
 for i,reg in enumerate(plan):
  if reg['color']!=last:rp.dip(reg['color']);last=reg['color']
  path=join_region(reg,labels)
  rp.stroke(path)
  print(i,reg['color'],'area',reg['area'],'points',len(path),'steps',s.n_steps,'sec',round(time.time()-t,1),flush=True)
  if i%10==0:Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE+'/progress.png')
 rp.move([0,0,.108],.12,12)
 a=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(a,BASE+'/trajectory.npz')
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE+'/painting.png')
 np.save(BASE+'/ink.npy',s.ink())
 sc=s.status();json.dump(sc,open(BASE+'/score.json','w'),indent=2);print(json.dumps(sc),flush=True)
 s.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
